name: The Missing Scholar

angles.text: As a Mage, you share Flamebreeze's curiosity about the windborne arcane currents gathering in Zephras's highlands.
As a Skyborne, you know Zephras's winds and atmospheric magic hold great interest. Hidden dangers make the terrain perilous even for scholars.

faq.answer: Fillion Flamebreeze is a scholar of the High Order on Zephras. He set out to study windborne magic in the Shen'dar Highlands, then disappeared along the road.

Fillion Flamebreeze never reached his destination. His discarded satchel lies along the western road toward the Shen'dar Highlands, marked with his embroidered name and specks of dried blood that suggest an attack.
The High Order gathers and preserves knowledge across Zephras. Its work has grown more perilous amid wild magical phenomena and threats along the roads.

aliases: why did he go to the highlands
faq.answer: Fillion Flamebreeze traveled to the Shen'dar Highlands to record unusual windborne magic pooling and flowing across parts of the highlands.
faq.q: Why was Fillion travelling to the Shen'dar Highlands?

faq.answer: Fillion Flamebreeze's bloodstained satchel lies along the westward road from Valanaar as it climbs toward the Shen'dar Highlands.
faq.q: Where was Fillion Flamebreeze last seen?

faq.answer: Windborne magic is made up of atmospheric arcane currents that gather naturally in certain high places on Zephras. The Shen'dar Highlands are a chief subject of arcane research.
faq.q: What is the windborne magic of the Shen'dar Highlands?

sections.body: The High Order gathers and preserves knowledge across Zephras. Yet field research on the island has grown perilous. Fillion Flamebreeze set out for the Shen'dar Highlands to study atmospheric arcane phenomena, but never reported back. His peers now fear the dangers along the frontier roads have claimed him.
sections.title: The High Order's Mission

sections.body: Fillion Flamebreeze left Valanaar and traveled west toward the Shen'dar Highlands. There, he meant to study windborne magic pooling among the peaks. He vanished before completing the journey. Along the route, a search finds only his personal satchel in the dirt. Dried blood stains it, and his survival is in grave doubt.
sections.title: Traces on the Western Road

summary: Fillion Flamebreeze is missing after setting out to study atmospheric magic on Zephras. The High Order sent the scholar toward the Shen'dar Highlands, and concern grows as the road from Valanaar yields no word of his return.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Scholar
